topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I arrived home today, and there on my doorstep, was a beautiful bouquet of flowers, vibrant with colors that seemed to shout joy and life. No card, no note, just a bundle of blooms wrapped in green paper. I stood there for a moment, the silence of my home ringing louder with each passing second. I couldn’t help but wonder who could have sent them. My mind raced through possibilities, each scenario more fanciful than the last. After a while, I gathered the courage to bring them inside, placing them gently on the kitchen counter. I took a deep breath,trying to let the sweetness of the gesture overshadow the mystery of it all. Maybe, just maybe, that’s what the sender intended.
